mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or equivalent competent authority of the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the duly signed incorporation consent and director nomination form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian notary public and licensed resident agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory customer due diligence under Ley No. 23 de 2015 and Executive Decree No. 168 de 2005. The resident agent and incorporation counsel must screen each shareholder, beneficial owner, intended director, and signatory against the UAF national PEP list, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN List, and any applicable domestic judicial restrictions. PEP status must be declared in writing and enhanced due diligence is mandatory, including identification of source of wealth and source of funds, with senior management approval required before acceptance of any PEP relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Servicio de Registro en Línea (https://www.registro-publico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name may be expressed in Spanish or in any language using Latin script. If the proposed name uses non-Latin script, such as Chinese for the hotpot brand, it must be transliterated into Latin characters and the transliteration must be certified. The name must include the legal-form suffix 'Sociedad Anónima' or 'S.A.'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for 30 calendar days and may not be extended. Upon expiry, a new application must be submitted with the required fee. If the name is administratively rejected on grounds of similarity to an existing registered name or use of a restricted token, the applicant or resident agent may file a written reconsideration request with the Dirección General de Personas Jurídicas of the Registro Público de Panamá within five business days. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may appeal to the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso Administrativo de la Corte Suprema de Justicia under Law 38 of 2000.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible. Panama's General Corporation Law requires a resident agent (agente residente) maintaining a physical address in Panama, which may serve as the registered office. For this overseas-format hotpot restaurant chain, a virtual or concierge registered office at the resident agent's address is acceptable provided the Panamanian entity does not conduct physical licensed activities within Panama and all host-state operating licenses are obtained where dining operations occur.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — quantified at less than 5% annual probability. The Panamanian DGI and Registro Público do not routinely conduct unannounced on-site inspections at the registered agent's address for a pure holding or foreign-operating company with no taxable Panamanian operations; inspection risk increases only upon tax audit flags, local ITBMS filings, or resident agent compliance deficiencies.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (General Corporation Law of Panama), as amended, notably Title I, Articles 1-49 on incorporation, share capital, directors, and registered agent; supplemented by the Unicoo Reglamento del Registro Público (Regulatory Rules of the Public Registry).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Micro Jurisdicción Mercantil / Mercantile Section
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) executed before a Panama Notary and registered with the Registro Público de Panamá
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-in capital is required by law. Share capital may be nominal; no escrow account or capital deposit verification is mandated for a standard Sociedad Anónima under Law 32 of 1927.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION I: The Subscribers, by unanimous written consent, adopt the Company’s Articles of Incorporation and subscribe to the shares as set forth in the capital schedule, having paid in the capital at par value in accordance with the statute. RESOLVED: the registered office of the Company is established at the address provided in the Incorporation Deed, and the registered agent is appointed to receive legal process. RESOLVED: the appointment of the President, Treasurer, and Secretary is ratified, with full authority to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and initiate the Company’s operational licenses. RESOLVED: the Corporate Secretary is directed to file all necessary documents and pay all statutory fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Corporate Existence Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Oficina de Denominaciones (Name Reservation Office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a prior name availability search using the online portal of the Registro Público. Submit a formal name reservation application in Spanish, providing three proposed names in descending preference. The reservation is valid for 30 days and must precede drafting of the deed.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request form
Identity of applicants or their legal counsel
Proposed corporate name(s)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as deceptively similar, file an administrative reconsideration with the same office or submit an alternative name promptly. No fee refund is granted, but the applicant may re-file immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Republic of Panama (Circuito Notarial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Escritura Pública de Constitución containing corporate name, object clause, capital structure, director provisions, registered agent appointment, and duration. All subscribers or their qualified attorney-in-fact must appear before a Panamanian notary for execution and legalization of signatures.
required_dossiers: Notarized draft deed of incorporation
Valid passports or identity documents of subscribers/directors
Approved name reservation certificate
Registered agent acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies formal defects, amend the deed through an addendum and re-execute before the same notary. The corrected deed supersedes the previous version for registration purposes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registry Filing and Corporate Legal Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the fully executed Public Deed, along with the office’s electronic payment and standardized filing cover sheet, within the 30-day deadline from notarization. The registry assigns the corporate identification folio and issues the Registro Público certificate, thereby granting legal personality.
required_dossiers: Original executed Escritura Pública de Constitución
Copy of the notary’s authorization page
Registered agent acceptance
Proof of payment of registry filing fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues an 'r' notice citing omissions, cure within the assigned term by filing a correcting note or supplementary deed; otherwise the registration is archived. A formal appeal to the Director of the Registro Público may be filed within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Identification and Municipal Business Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministry of Economy and Finance; Municipality of the operating district
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the corporate formation certificate and the registered deed with the DGI to obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente). Concurrently apply for the Aviso de Operación at the municipal treasury of the restaurant’s operating district, designating the commercial activity, physical address, and legal representative.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered incorporation deed
Certificate of registry officer
RUC application form
Municipal Aviso de Operación application form
Identification of legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI delays RUC issuance, present a formal written request and the registry certificate; if the municipality withholds the Aviso de Operación, correct zoning, land use, or address discrepancies and resubmit with the curative letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Corporate Governance and Registered Agent Recordal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute and register the First Board Resolution, appointing directors/officers and ratifying the registered agent and office. File the directors’ acceptance and the registered agent’s consent; also notify all commercial banks and counterparties of the corporate resolution and authorizing officers.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution executed by the board
Acceptance letters of appointed officers
Registered agent consent and address confirmation
Proof of publication or payment of applicable franchise tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry questions lack of sworn acceptance, obtain notarized acceptances and file a corrective amendment. Any officer changes require a new board resolution and separate registration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) – Dirección Nacional de Salud Pública / Regulación Sanitaria; additionally the local Municipality’s Public Health and Economic Activity Licensing Office
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación con Naturaleza de Licencia Comercial de Restaurante (municipal commercial license) and Permiso Sanitario de Funcionamiento (health operating permit)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II (low-impact environmental registration) for a full-service restaurant with domestic kitchen operations, limited liquid waste discharge, and no significant industrial emissions; an EIA Report is not mandatory for this use.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with MiAMBIENTE Resolution No. 653 (maximum permissible limits) for wastewater: pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 ≤ 220 mg/L, COD ≤ 400 mg/L, TSS ≤ 100 mg/L, fats and oils ≤ 20 mg/L; kitchen exhaust must comply with nuisance odor and particulate controls; solid waste handling must follow segregated disposal and grease trap management protocols under MINSA’s sanitation rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá (fire brigade) confirming adequate fire suppression systems, escape routes, and kitchen exhaust cleaning; structural load certificate for dining and mezzanine areas issued by a licensed Panamanian structural engineer; workplace safety clearance for employees, including sanitary hot zones, electrical grounding, first-aid provisions, and COVID/health protocols under Resolution No. 001-2020 of the Ministry of Labor.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no central bank and no exchange-control authority. Banking supervision lies with the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP); Banco Nacional de Panamá (BNP) acts as the State's fiscal agent and clearing-house operator. The country is fully dollarized: the US Dollar is legal tender, and the Balboa circulates only as coinage pegged 1:1 to the USD (Decree-Law No. 84 of 1941, as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Complete convertibility on both current and capital accounts; no licensing, approval, quota, or allocation restrictions apply to any currency. Profit remittance faces zero FX impediment; the sole friction is the 10% Panamanian dividend withholding tax on distributions made by the Sociedad Anónima (reduced statutory rate is available to qualifying small taxpayers), which the paying bank must evidence as settled before disbursement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no mandatory conversion ratio, no statutory repatriation deadline, and no surrender obligation on export receipts. Proceeds from the hotpot condiment line and franchise supply may be retained 100% in USD or any freely chosen foreign currency, in Panama or abroad.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banco Nacional de Panamá (state fiscal agent)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium as a supplementary liquidity channel, Low as a substitute for local clearing rails. The SBP confines deposit-taking and merchant-acquiring to licensed banks and to entities admitted into its Innovation Hub sandbox; cross-border EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) without a Panamanian license may not lawfully hold client funds or settle USD/ACH locally. They remain viable for non-core procurement cards and virtual disbursements, but all POS acquiring and payroll accounts for the hotpot chain must sit within an SBP-licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, fully remote onboarding is not granted to newly introduced foreign-owned S.A.s. SBP due-diligence rules require positive identification of signatories and beneficial owners: at least one authorized director or signatory must appear physically before a Panamanian bank officer, or complete a notarized interview before a recognized foreign notary with an apostilled KYC package. Video-call identification is accepted only for existing bank relationships after an initial face-to-face meeting, and never for the opening of a capital escrow account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-owner transparency deficit: layered S.A.-over-foundation structure, nominee shareholders, or legacy bearer instruments
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the share ledger in custody of the resident agent; notarized shareholder registry; final-beneficiary declaration filed with Panama's Beneficial Owner Registry; a Panamanian counsel legal-opinion letter identifying every natural-person UBO with exact share percentages.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or FATF grey-list exposure in the China-to-Latin-America procurement corridor and remittances routed through high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC/EU/SBP corporate screening results; 36 months of bank statements and source-of-funds records; complete supplier file (commercial invoice, ICPO, bill of lading); adopted AML/KYC internal policy naming a locally resident compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unmatched one-time capital injection: lump-sum shareholder advance disproportionate to the restaurant's projected revenues
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution formally authorizing the contribution; last two years' audited or accountant-reviewed financial statements of the investing shareholder; home-jurisdiction tax clearance and bank reference; sworn source-of-wealth statement executed under penalty of perjury.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived absence of economic substance in Panama (no office, no payroll, no local management) inconsistent with an active trading company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Office or warehouse lease; Panama payroll records; local board-meeting minutes; Panama economic-substance filings with the tax authority; export license and health-certification documents for the condiment line evidencing genuine operational activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route injected equity exclusively through SBP-licensed banks using SWIFT MT103, with Field 70 reading 'Capital Contribution – Subscription of Shares of Panamanian S.A.'. Panama does not apply BOP purpose codes because USD is legal tender; the receiving bank instead validates the remitter's source-of-funds statement, the corporate capital-increase minute, and the treasurer's deposit certificate. Funds are placed in a Capital Escrow Account until the contribution is recorded in the corporate ledger, then swept to the Operational Account for restaurant CAPEX and working capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for standard condiment and equipment vendor invoices; (ii) SWIFT MT700 documentary letters of credit with a confirming bank for high-value imports of Chinese hotpot ingredients and custom kitchen equipment; (iii) local merchant-acquiring settlements for in-store POS receipts cleared through the BNP-operated Panamanian ACH and Visa/Mastercard networks on a T+1/T+2 basis; and (iv) Fedwire/CHIPS via US correspondent banks for large-dollar cross-border wires. Every outbound disbursement requires matching invoice, LC terms where applicable, and OFAC pre-screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable USD/LCY FX forwards (up to 24 months) negotiated with SBP-licensed banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted currencies such as CNY/CNH arising from Chinese procurement and franchise flows
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for medium-term intercompany shareholder loans or royalty streams
OTC vanilla FX options purchased for downside protection on committed vendor payments
Natural-hedge structuring: invoicing overseas hotpot affiliates in local functional currency while centralizing USD treasury management in Panama

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% marginal rate (progressive: 20% on the first PAB/USD 1,500,000 of net taxable income; 25% on the excess)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial system: all foreign-source income of the overseas hotpot restaurant and condiment supply chain is wholly exempt; Panama-source income benefits from the USD 1,500,000 progressive band and full deduction of ordinary and necessary business expenses; no statutory tax holiday applies to a full-service dining chain, but non-domiciled offshore S.As pay no Panamanian ISR on offshore operations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form D-04 (Declaración Jurada Anual de Impuesto sobre la Renta de Personas Jurídicas); filed through the Panamanian DGI electronic portal (E-Tax 2.0) at dgi.mef.gob.pa.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, with monthly advance ISR payments (pagos a cuenta) for taxpayers above the statutory revenue threshold.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within three calendar months after the fiscal year-end; for the standard December 31 year-end, the deadline is March 31 of the following tax year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, RUC, fiscal domicile, resident agent details, and corporate activity code (ISIC 5610).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The offshore S.A. must identify its registered resident agent in Panama; foreign directors require no Panamanian DIM and are not tax-resident merely by holding directorships.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenues recorded under Panamanian GAAP, including local and foreign receipts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter zero for non-domiciled S.As whose hotpot revenues arise wholly outside Panama; foreign-source turnover is excluded by the territorial principle.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts derived from Panama-source activities, such as local condiment sales, local franchise fees, or Panama POS/merchant acquiring settlement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-domiciled S.As enter zero unless local operations, a permanent establishment, or Panama-based management exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2 / Costo de ventas y gastos operativos
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs and expenses allocated to the production of Panama-source income only.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only expenses connected to Panama-source revenue; offshore restaurant operating costs are not reportable in the D-04.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net income equal to Panama-source gross revenue minus allowable allocated expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a pure offshore hotpot chain, the taxable base is zero and the return is effectively an informative declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Progressive computation of corporate income tax at 20% up to PAB/USD 1,500,000 and 25% on the excess of net taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-domiciled S.As with only foreign-source income compute zero ISR on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 5 / Pagos a cuenta y créditos
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Monthly advance payments, third-party withholding credits, and credits for taxes paid in Panama on the same income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign resident lenders or shareholders have no Panamanian advance payments; any excess withholding must be credited or refunded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 / Impuesto resultante o saldo a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax payable or refundable balance after credits; payment is made in PAB/USD through the DGI portal.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-domiciled offshore S.A. reports a zero tax balance while remaining subject to the annual corporate flat tax and Mercantile Registry fees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of form D-04 triggers fines from PAB/USD 50 to PAB/USD 5,000 per period; late payment accrues a 5% monthly surcharge capped at 25% plus 1% monthly moratory interest; persistent non-filing exposes the S.A. to RUC suspension, cancellation of fiscal domicile, and loss of access to refunds and treaty relief.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding on gross dividends paid out of Panama-source profits; 5% reduced rate where the distributing S.A. is fiscally domiciled and has paid the complementary tax on distributed reserves; 0% on dividends paid exclusively from exempt foreign-source income under the territorial principle.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident shareholder invoking a DTA must obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from its home jurisdiction, submit the TRC and a treaty-relief request to the Panamanian paying agent before the dividend record date, and file the standard DGI exemption application; Panama's DTA network is limited, with in-force treaties including Spain, Portugal, Luxembourg, Mexico, South Korea, Qatar, and the UAE, and relief is denied to residents of non-treaty states.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and technical-assistance fees for intangibles used in Panama are subject to a 12.5% statutory final withholding tax for non-residents, with possible DTA reductions in the 5% to 10% range; cross-border interest paid to a non-resident lender is generally outside Panamanian WHT when the lending activity and funds are used abroad, while interest chargeable to Panama-source business may be subject to the same 12.5% final withholding absent treaty protection.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: PAB/USD 6,000,000 of gross annual revenue in the preceding tax year triggers mandatory preparation and disclosure of the Local File, Master File, and transfer pricing annex under Executive Decree No. 233/2016; transactions below that amount still require arm's-length pricing and contemporaneous support.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama does not apply the Caribbean-style Economic Substance Regulations; instead, it applies the binary test of fiscal domicile. An S.A. with offshore hotpot operations remains non-domiciled and outside Panamanian ISR if board control, management, and records remain abroad; if board decisions are made in Panama, local employees are hired, or Panama-source revenue is generated through merchant acquiring or POS rails, the S.A. becomes fiscally domiciled and must maintain real local substance, books, and employees to sustain its tax position.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Under-Declaration of Panama-Source Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing Panama POS or merchant-acquiring receipts from hotpot and condiment sales into private offshore accounts, related PIFs, or nominee bank accounts and omitting those revenues from D-04; inflating expenses through forged supplier invoices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal and tax sanctions under the Código Fiscal and Código Penal: fine of 100% to 300% of evaded tax, monthly 5% surcharge capped at 25%, 1% monthly moratory interest, RUC cancellation, and imprisonment from 2 to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Signing directors and officers are jointly and severally liable for evaded tax and penalties; the DGI may issue travel bans, freeze local assets, and the responsible director faces up to 5 years' imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a real full-service hotpot dining chain and condiment supply business through a non-domiciled Panamanian S.A. while holding board meetings in Panama, employing Panamanian staff, or contractually controlling restaurant funds through Panama.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-characterization of the S.A. as fiscally domiciled with retroactive ISR at 20%/25% on all Panama-source income; fines up to PAB/USD 5,000; cancellation of RUC and Mercantile Registry registration; loss of limited liability shield.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee and managing directors face piercing of the corporate veil and personal liability for unpaid corporate taxes, travel bans, and a prohibition on acting as directors for up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Money Laundering Through Cash-Intensive Restaurant
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Depositing large unreported cash proceeds from the hotpot chain into Panamanian bank accounts in structured amounts to avoid threshold reporting, or failing to file suspicious transaction reports required by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Sanctions under Ley 23 de 2015 and the Panamanian AML framework: fines from USD 10,000 to USD 1,000,000 per violation, asset forfeiture, and imprisonment from 5 to 10 years for principals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives are personally charged with money-laundering offenses, disqualified from financial and corporate management, subjected to travel bans during investigation, and exposed to seizure of personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation / Artificial Condiment Supply Pricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Under-pricing the cross-border sale of hotpot condiments, trademarks, and franchise royalties from the Panamanian S.A. to the overseas restaurant affiliate to shift corporate profits and circumvent the arm's-length standard; failing to prepare the Local/Master File once revenue exceeds PAB/USD 6,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI transfer pricing adjustment to arm's length; reassessed ISR plus 5% monthly surcharge capped at 25%, 1% monthly interest, a valuation penalty of 10% to 25% of the adjustment, and document-production fines up to PAB/USD 10,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The CFO and directors who certified the TP documentation face joint personal liability for the tax deficiency, and responsible officers may be barred from future DGI administrative proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Persistent Non-Filing / Dissolution and Loss of Cross-Border Veil
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the annual D-04 and pay the annual corporate flat tax for three consecutive fiscal years while the S.A. continues to own the overseas hotpot restaurants, bank accounts, and trademark rights.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Dissolution of the corporation by the DGI and Mercantile Registry, cancellation of the RUC, fines up to PAB/USD 5,000, loss of standing to sue, and blockage of profit repatriation through Panama.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: After dissolution for non-filing, directors become personally accountable for unfiled taxes, statutory penalties, and creditor restitution; travel bans are issued to secure their appearance and personal assets may be attached.
